name: @sponsorcoin/merit-connect
description: Merit Connect: the protocol one Merit wallet uses to ask another Merit wallet who is connected, for its accounts, and for signatures. No dependencies; the transport (Chrome extension messaging, a web page, a test loopback) is injected.

scripts.test: npm run build && node test/protocol.test.mjs && node test/relay.test.mjs && node test/responder.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs && node test/transports.test.mjs && node test/mutants.mjs
